summary: An OpenAI researcher states that the computation graph depth of current frontier models (including a model called Astra) is within a factor of two of GPT-4, and that OpenAI has worked to preserve chain-of-thought monitorability.

practices.reason: The claim that OpenAI preserves and uses chain-of-thought monitoring describes an internal safety-evaluation practice, but it is not a transferable method a team could replicate.
practices.quote: OpenAI has worked to preserve and utilize chain-of-thought monitoring since
